name: text-vertical-word-roll
title: Vertical Word Roll
description: Từ cũ cuộn lên khỏi khung, từ mới cuộn lên thế chỗ cùng lúc, lệch nhau từng ký tự 0.02 giây.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Two words stacked in one clip window (one line tall + 0.08 em). At the swap, old chars y 0 → −100 % and new chars +100 % → 0 at the same time, char by char 20 ms apart (capped 0.25 s), 0.5 s easeInOutCubic (labelled power3.inOut). Demo swaps at 0.6 s (A → B) and 2.3 s (B → A); loop 3.6 s. View-transition variant: whole word, 0.4 s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) with a fade. Params: to: từ mới · duration (0.5 s) · stagger (0.02 s) · ease (easeInOutCubic).
